header:
The sequencer's once-per-pass service: on Variant_Flag 2 zeroes the playing-track mask (0x60341E) and record mask (0x3000); runs the request consumers sub_F44623, sub_F44809 ((0x34D3) bit 0, Seq_RequestRewind's flag), Seq_LocateToSongPosition, Seq_StopPlaybackOnRequest ((0x34D2) bit 1) and others,
then sub_F44E8E for each track 0..16 set in (0x3738)/(0x373A); ends (0x34B2) := (0x60341E). Called at the end of every MainTask_Loop pass and by Transport_StopWhileRecording. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:6295 `call T_F409C8` -- MainTask_Loop's tail, unconditional on every pass, just before `jrl MainTask_Loop` (T_F409C8 -> sub_F44582, prom_b:89642)

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93620 `ld (6304798:24), xwa` -- ... (0x60341E) := 0 (playing-track mask) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93621 `ld (12288:16), xwa` -- ... and (0x3000) := 0 (record mask), every pass
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93638 `calr sub_F44809` -- consumer of (0x34D3) bit 0 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93918 `m_bit 0, MD16, 0x34d3` -- ... which Seq_RequestRewind sets (prom_b:95480)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93645 `calr Seq_LocateToSongPosition` -- the MIDI song-position consumer
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93649 `calr Seq_StopPlaybackOnRequest` -- the (0x34D2) bit 1 stop consumer
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93670 `calr sub_F44E8E` -- per track 0..16 in the (0x3738)/(0x373A) mask

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:93731 `; Seq_LocateToSongPosition: from the sequencer tick (sub_F44582)` -- earlier headers already treat it as the sequencer's periodic pass

The shared SMF event handlers (SmfMeta_SetTempo, SmfCC_PutParamEventWithNumber, sub_F7083B, sub_F70B22) apply it to the track counter (0x11B2) for format 1 with 2+ tracks before TrackCursor_Load. Basis: callers + body + twin.
